evidence.excerpt: outstanding_q must correctly track the existence of a pending DMI request (set when a request is sent, cleared when response received) so that dmi_resp_ready_o is only high when appropriate.
When reset is active low, outstanding_q is cleared to 0 immediately.
tl_d2h_o_pre.a_ready is asserted only when dmi_req_ready_i is high and no request is outstanding.
tl_d2h_o_pre.d_valid is asserted when there is an outstanding request and either the DMI response is valid or an error is queued.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) (!outstanding_q) |-> (!dmi_resp_ready_o));

findings.title: 在读请求地址未对齐（rd_req 且 a_address[1:0] != 00）时，error_d 未被任何 guarantee 显式覆盖，可能导致未对齐 DMI 读请求被错误地发出，违反 DMI 协议对齐要求或造成地址解析错误。
findings.contradiction: 在读请求地址未对齐（rd_req 且 a_address[1:0] != 00）时，error_d 未被任何 guarantee 显式覆盖，可能导致未对齐 DMI 读请求被错误地发出，违反 DMI 协议对齐要求或造成地址解析错误。

evidence.excerpt: When (wr_req || rd_req) is true and tl_h2d_i.a_address is not word-aligned (a_address[1:0] != 2'b00), error_d must be asserted to prevent dmi_req_valid_o from going high.
addr_align_err is asserted when a write request is active and the lower two bits of the address are nonzero.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) ((wr_req || rd_req) && tl_h2d_i.a_address[1:0] != 2'b00) |-> error_d);

findings.title: 模块 tlul_adapter_dmi 未对参数 top_pkg::TL_AW 的最小值进行静态检查。当 TL_AW < 2 时，内部地址切片 tl_h2d_i.a_address[top_pkg::TL_AW-1:2] 将产生非法索引，导致综合错误或非预期行为。缺少编译时断言保证 TL_AW >= 2，使错误在集成阶段才暴露且信息不清晰。
findings.contradiction: 模块 tlul_adapter_dmi 未对参数 top_pkg::TL_AW 的最小值进行静态检查。当 TL_AW < 2 时，内部地址切片 tl_h2d_i.a_address[top_pkg::TL_AW-1:2] 将产生非法索引，导致综合错误或非预期行为。缺少编译时断言保证 TL_AW >= 2，使错误在集成阶段才暴露且信息不清晰。

evidence.excerpt: If top_pkg::TL_AW is less than 2, the address slicing tl_h2d_i.a_address[top_pkg::TL_AW-1:2] is illegal, causing synthesis error or unexpected behavior.
tl_err is the output of the tlul_err instance u_err, which monitors tl_h2d_i for TL-UL protocol violations.
A compile-time assertion checks that the top-level data width matches the DMI request data width.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) (top_pkg::TL_AW >= 2));

findings.title: outstanding_q 仅在 a_ack 时置 1、复位时清 0，但没有任何逻辑在请求完成（例如 DMI 响应返回）时将其清零。这会导致适配器误认为始终有请求未完成，可能引发 dmi_resp_ready_o 持续有效或适配器永久阻塞。
findings.contradiction: outstanding_q 仅在 a_ack 时置 1、复位时清 0，但没有任何逻辑在请求完成（例如 DMI 响应返回）时将其清零。这会导致适配器误认为始终有请求未完成，可能引发 dmi_resp_ready_o 持续有效或适配器永久阻塞。

evidence.excerpt: outstanding_q correctly tracks whether a request is pending and is set/cleared elsewhere.
After a_ack is asserted and reset is not active, outstanding_q is set to 1 on the next rising edge.
When reset is active low, outstanding_q is cleared to 0 immediately.
dmi_resp_ready_o is asserted iff outstanding_q is true and error_q is false.

findings.title: dmi_req_ready_i 作为 DMI 就绪指示器，适配器假设其准确可靠。但 DTM 规范未提供任何保证来约束该信号的生成逻辑。若 DTM 实现时错误地置位或保持该信号，将导致适配器在 DMI 未就绪时发起请求，可能丢失或破坏请求。
findings.contradiction: dmi_req_ready_i 作为 DMI 就绪指示器，适配器假设其准确可靠。但 DTM 规范未提供任何保证来约束该信号的生成逻辑。若 DTM 实现时错误地置位或保持该信号，将导致适配器在 DMI 未就绪时发起请求，可能丢失或破坏请求。

evidence.excerpt: dmi_req_ready_i accurately indicates the DMI's readiness to accept a request.
req_ready is the logical AND of dmi_req_ready and dmi_resp_ready.
When dmi_resp_valid is high and the set condition (dmi_req_ready && dmi_req_valid && !pending_req_q) is false, pending_req_q is cleared to 0 in the next cycle.
When pending_req_q is 0 and both dmi_req_ready and dmi_req_valid are high, pending_req_q is set to 1 in the next cycle.

findings.title: The tlul_adapter_dmi assumes dmi_resp_valid_i is only asserted for valid DMI responses, but the source module (tlul_jtag_dtm, which appears to generate dmi_resp_valid) does not provide any property th
findings.contradiction: The tlul_adapter_dmi assumes dmi_resp_valid_i is only asserted for valid DMI responses, but the source module (tlul_jtag_dtm, which appears to generate dmi_resp_valid) does not provide any property that restricts dmi_resp_valid to such valid states. Without this restriction, a false assertion of dmi_resp_valid_i could cause the adapter to emit an invalid response onto the TL bus, violating the bus protocol.

evidence.excerpt:
dmi_resp_valid_i is asserted only when a valid DMI response is available.
risk: False assertion causes the adapter to present an invalid response on the TL bus, violating protocol.
When dmi_resp_valid is high and the set condition (dmi_req_ready && dmi_req_valid && !pending_req_q) is false, pending_req_q is cleared to 0 in the next cycle.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) (!pending_req_q) |-> (!dmi_resp_valid));

findings.title: tlul_adapter_dmi 中 dmi_resp_ready_o 的生成逻辑未根据 outstanding_q 的状态进行控制，可能导致在仍有未完成请求时过早向 DMI 接口指示响应就绪，或在请求完成后未能及时就绪，引发 DMI 握手协议错误或死锁。
findings.contradiction: tlul_adapter_dmi 中 dmi_resp_ready_o 的生成逻辑未根据 outstanding_q 的状态进行控制，可能导致在仍有未完成请求时过早向 DMI 接口指示响应就绪，或在请求完成后未能及时就绪，引发 DMI 握手协议错误或死锁。

evidence.excerpt: outstanding_q is driven externally. Its management must be verified to track the DMI request/response handshake correctly, preventing premature or missing assertion of dmi_resp_ready_o.
dmi_req, dmi_req_valid, and dmi_resp_ready are directly driven by the dmi_jtag instance outputs.
req_ready is the logical AND of dmi_req_ready and dmi_resp_ready.
tl_d2h_o_pre.a_ready is asserted only when dmi_req_ready_i is high and no request is outstanding.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) (dmi_req_valid_i && (outstanding_q == 0)) |-> dmi_resp_ready_o);

findings.title: 在写响应期间，d_data 被假设为全1，但没有任何 guarantee 确保该行为。硬件可能不会将 d_data 驱动为全1（例如遗漏逻辑或保留为复位值），导致下游逻辑收到不确定数据。
findings.contradiction: 在写响应期间，d_data 被假设为全1，但没有任何 guarantee 确保该行为。硬件可能不会将 d_data 驱动为全1（例如遗漏逻辑或保留为复位值），导致下游逻辑收到不确定数据。

evidence.excerpt: Write responses (wr_req_q == 1) force d_data to all-ones.
dmi_req_o.op equals DTM_WRITE when wr_req is true, DTM_READ when rd_req is true, and DTM_NOP otherwise.
dmi_req_valid_o is asserted iff (wr_req or rd_req) is true and error_d is false.
be_err is asserted when a write request is active and the byte-enable mask is not all ones.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) (wr_req_q) |-> (d_data == {top_pkg::TL_DW{1'b1}}));

findings.title: 设计假设在 error_resp 或写请求时 d_data 为全1，但硬件中没有任何逻辑驱动 d_data 满足此约束，可能导致安全相关数据泄露或协议不符合预期。
findings.contradiction: 设计假设在 error_resp 或写请求时 d_data 为全1，但硬件中没有任何逻辑驱动 d_data 满足此约束，可能导致安全相关数据泄露或协议不符合预期。

evidence.excerpt: On error_resp or write requests, d_data is forced to all-ones. The comment says 'Blank data upon error', but it is unclear whether this is a security wipe (prevent secret leakage) or just a protocol p
dmi_req_o.op equals DTM_WRITE when wr_req is true, DTM_READ when rd_req is true, and DTM_NOP otherwise.
dmi_req_valid_o is asserted iff (wr_req or rd_req) is true and error_d is false.
When a_ack is asserted and not reset, rdata_q is updated to all-ones if (error_i || err_internal || wr_req) is true, otherwise to rdata_i.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) (error_resp || wr_req_q) |-> (d_data == '1));

findings.title: 硬件缺失保证 rd_req_q 和 wr_req_q 在请求被接受时正确捕获读/写类型并与 outstanding_q 保持一致的逻辑，可能导致 DMI 响应操作码错误。
findings.contradiction: 硬件缺失保证 rd_req_q 和 wr_req_q 在请求被接受时正确捕获读/写类型并与 outstanding_q 保持一致的逻辑，可能导致 DMI 响应操作码错误。

evidence.excerpt:
rspop_q, reqsz_q, reqid_q, rd_req_q, wr_req_q hold the corresponding information from the previously accepted request and are consistent with outstanding_q.
risk: Corrupted or mismatched request info
On asynchronous reset (rst_ni low), all request capture registers are cleared: reqid_q and reqsz_q to '0, rspop_q to AccessAck, error_q to 1'b0, wr_req_q and rd_req_q to 1'b0.
When not in reset and a_ack is deasserted, reqid_q, reqsz_q, and rspop_q retain their previous values.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) $rose(outstanding_q) |-> (rd_req_q == $past(rd_req)) && (wr_req_q == $past(wr_req)));

The tlul_err instance u_err must assert tl_err whenever the TL-UL protocol rules are violated on tl_h2d_i.
risk: If u_err fails to detect a protocol violation, tl_err remains low and error_d will not

findings.title: intg_error 信号在 CmdIntgCheck 为假的合法配置下未赋值，可能导致仿真 X 或综合警告，应在声明时提供默认值或显式赋为 0。

When CmdIntgCheck is true, intg_error is driven by instance u_cmd_intg_chk, which checks command integrity of tl_i and outputs a persistent error indication.

findings.contradiction: addr_align_err only ensures word-alignment (lower two address bits zero). evidence.excerpt: In StWrReadBackInit and StWrReadBackDWait, the d_ack response is expected to correspond to the write transaction that activated the readback (the one that set hold_tx_data).

findings.title: EnableReadback 为真时，读回检查寄存器 rdback_check_q 和 rdback_en_q 直接采样 d 输入，但设计未要求 rdback_check_d / rdback_en_d 为有效 Mubi4 值。非法 d 输入将造成 q 值脱离 {MuBi4True, MuBi4False}，使得基于松散/严格检测的读回使能逻辑出现误触发或漏检。
findings.contradiction: EnableReadback 为真时，读回检查寄存器 rdback_check_q 和 rdback_en_q 直接采样 d 输入，但设计未要求 rdback_check_d / rdback_en_d 为有效 Mubi4 值。非法 d 输入将造成 q 值脱离 {MuBi4True, MuBi4False}，使得基于松散/严格检测的读回使能逻辑出现误触发或漏检。

evidence.excerpt: rdback_en_q and rdback_check_q must always hold valid Mubi4 encodings (i.e., strictly MuBi4True or MuBi4False).
When EnableReadback is false, rdback_check_q=MuBi4False, rdback_en_q=MuBi4False.
When EnableReadback is true, rdback_check_q and rdback_en_q sample their d-inputs on clk_i while rst_ni is deasserted.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) (EnableReadback) |-> (rdback_check_d inside {MuBi4True, MuBi4False} && rdback_en_d inside {MuBi4True, MuBi4False}));

findings.title: 设计未对 sram_d_ack 的 assertion 条件施加任何约束或检测。在 StWaitRd 状态下，如果 sram_d_ack 来自不相关的事务，FSM 会错误地提前跳转到 StWriteCmd，可能造成数据损坏或安全检查绕过。

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) (state_q == StWaitRd && sram_d_ack) |-> (pending_txn_cnt == 1));
